description: One-call identity + industry-financial-ties transparency profile for a US healthcare prescriber. Joins two keyless federal sources: the NPPES NPI Registry (identity - NPI, specialty, city/state, active status) and CMS Open Payments / Sunshine Act (industry payments disclosed to that prescriber - total dollars, payment count, top paying manufacturers, and associated drugs/products for the most recent program year with data). Provide a last_name (ideally with first_name + state) or an exact 10-digit npi. The name resolver picks the NPPES record that genuinely matches the requested name (never a blind top hit), and payments are pinned to that exact NPI across recent program years. This is a TRANSPARENCY profile drawn from public records, NOT a judgment: industry payments to physicians are lawful and publicly disclosed, and their presence is not evidence of wrongdoing. A source that fails is noted, not fatal. Premium cross-source synthesis; verify against the primary sources.

first_name.description: Optional prescriber first name to disambiguate (e.g. 'Steven').

last_name.description: Prescriber last name (e.g. 'Nissen'). Provide this or an npi.

npi.description: Optional exact 10-digit NPI; overrides name search.

state.description: Optional 2-letter state to disambiguate the NPPES match (e.g. 'OH').

year.description: Optional 4-digit CMS program year (e.g. '2023'); defaults to the most recent year with disclosed payments.

name: prescriber_ties_profile
